description: Paths that run functions/_middleware.js. Everything else (JS, CSS, images, the app's other routes, the 404 page Pages answers unknown paths with, the app-site-association file) is served straight from build/ by Pages: free, unmetered, with _headers applied. /404 and /404.html are here because Pages would serve build/404.html at them with a 200. /about also matches /about/, and /i/* also matches /i.
